text:
A: Hello! Gareth, yeah? Tomasz. Finally, the last one.
B: Yeah, hello. Can hear you fine.
A: Good. I saw your photo, I said this guy is serious, files all labelled. You do something with numbers, right?
B: Quantity surveyor. Commercial manager at a contractor in Birmingham. Hospitals and schools.
A: I knew it. Surveyor. I said it, I wrote it down even.
B: Ha. What about you?
A: Cars. Premium German, dealership in Park Royal. New and approved used. I'm usually top three on the league table every month.
B: Right. Which brand?
A: I can't really say on this, mate, but you can guess. What do you drive?
B: 5 Series. Leased. It's in for a service this week, actually.
A: Okay, nice. Good car. Which spec?
B: M Sport.
A: Of course. Everybody wants M Sport. You lease through work or personal?
B: Personal, for now. Car allowance comes with the next job up, hopefully.
A: Next job up, what is it, director?
B: Commercial Director. Within five years, that's the plan. Here or somewhere bigger.
A: Same, same. I want sales manager in two years. Then maybe my own business, used prestige cars, with a friend. The manager now, honestly, he's not great. He's there because he's been there long time, you know what I mean.
B: Yeah. There's a lot of that about.
A: You got it too? Old guys blocking the door?
B: Something like that. I've gone for it twice. Didn't get it. Politics, mostly.
A: Politics. Always politics. You have to make numbers so big they can't ignore you, that's my thing. That's why I'm top. My manager doesn't like me, but he can't say nothing because of the numbers.
B: That works until it doesn't.
A: Ha. Maybe. Nice watch, by the way, in your photo? No, wait, that was mine.
B: Yours. I noticed it, to be fair. What is it?
A: Omega. Second-hand, but perfect condition, I got good price because the guy needed cash quick. Seamaster.
B: Nice. What does one of them go for?
A: New, five, six grand. I paid much less. I always pay less. Same with builders, plumbers, I get them to knock off.
B: That's most of my job, getting people to knock off.
A: See! Same job, different product. You play golf? You look like golf.
B: Saturdays. Handicap fourteen. Eighty-seven last week.
A: I don't know if that's good, but it sounds good. I tried once in Marbella, I hit the ball into a swimming pool.
B: That'll do it.
A: So, house, you own, yeah? Up there it's cheaper, everybody has house.
B: Four-bed detached. New-build in Shirley.
A: Four-bed detached. Mate, in Ealing that's like three million. I'm still renting, honestly, but I want to buy before I'm forty. Two years, so—
B: Better get saving, then.
A: Ha, yeah. Yeah, I know.
